sentences.text:
A
Counsel for Applicant :- Ankit Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.

1. Heard Sri Ankit Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Diwaker Singh,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

This Court vide order dated 11.04.2023 passed the following order:
"Heard Sri Ankit Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Alok Saran,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the impugned charge sheet dated 23.07.2022 filed in Case No.953 of 2022 Vikram And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

1 (State vs. Vikram and others) arising out of Case Crime No.0060 of 2022, under Sections 498A. 323, 504 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Kheri as well as summoning order dated 17.09.2022 passed by the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/ F.T.C. (Offene against Women), Lakhimpur Kheri in Case No.953 of 2022 (State vs. Vikram and others) arising out of Case Crime No.0060 of 2022, under Sections 498A. 323, 504 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Kheri.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicant No.1 happens to be the husband of opposite party No.2 and there is serious matrimonial discord between them, due to which, the applicants have been falsely implicated in the present case on the basis of false and concocted facts.
In view of the aforesaid, he has stated that the present proceeding is nothing but an abuse of the process of this Court.

He, thus,
submits that there is a possibility of resolution of their dispute through the process of mediation.
Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
However, he could not dispute the other factual submissions advanced by learned counsel for the applicants.
Having regard to the nature of dispute between the parties, there appears a fair possibility of resolution of their dispute through the process of mediation.
Issue notice to the opposite party No.2, returnable at an early date.
Steps be taken within a week.
List this matter on 16.05.2023.

On which date, the applicant No.1 and opposite party No.2 shall appear in person before this Court so that the possibility of amicable settlement of their dispute through the process of mediation may be explored.
The applicant No.1 shall deposit an amount of Rs.20,000/- within three weeks from today before the Senior Registrar of this Court.

Till the next date of listing, impugned summoning order dated 17.09.2022 or any process issued pursuant thereto, shall not be given effect to qua the applicants,
namely, Vikram, Karan Singh and Rani Devi.

It is made clear that in case of default in depositing the amount by the applicant No.1 as directed above or on non-appearance of the applicant No.1 before this Court on the next date of listing, the interim protection granted herein above shall automatically come to an end without any further reference of this Court."

sentences.text:
3.This Court vide order dated 11.04.2023, directed the applicant No. 1 to deposit Rs. 20,000/-
within three weeks from the date of order and an interim protection was granted to the applicants.
4.

Today, learned counsel for the applicants submits that in compliance of order dated 11.04.2023 the applicant No.1 could not deposit the amount of Rs. 20,000/- before the Senior Registrar of this Court and he prays for some further time to deposit the money.

5. I have perused the order dated 11.04.2023 passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court, wherein it has been clearly mentioned that in case of default in depositing the amount by the applicant No.1 as directed above or on non-appearance of the applicant No.1 before this Court on the next date of listing, the interim protection granted herein above shall automatically come to an end without any further reference of this Court.
6. It appears that applicants are not interested to deposit the said amount and they are adopting delaying tactics by not depositing the money as directed earlier and are enjoying fruits of interim protection.
Even though, steps has not been taken to serve the opposite party No.2.
The conduct of applicants is not bonafide.
7. In such circumstances, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is liable to be dismissed for non compliance of the order dated 11.04.2023.

8. Dismissed accordingly.
9.
Interim order, granted earlier, stands vacated.
Order Date :- 16.5.2023 Arvind  Vikram And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
